decisions.reason: The assessment-date copy consequence is already fully represented by the candidate's message-50 MODIFY.
Changing the assessment-date field format does not alter the required fonts, icons, or reusable design assets.
The assessment-date field refinement does not change the requirement that templates be straightforward to export as PDFs.
The assessment-date modification is independent of the warning's purpose and visual treatment; the warning change is already represented separately.
The assessment-date field format does not change the vehicle identifier or its presentation.
The page-one assessment-date placeholder does not change the footer requirement; the missing page-4 footer is separately represented as runtime evidence.
The assessment-date field refinement does not alter the content or format of the front-page result drivers.
A field-specific assessment-date correction does not modify the retained visual direction or cross-variant theme.
The source specifies replacement of assessment-date text on page one and does not change internal-page header coverage or content.
The assessment-date placeholder is separate from the score panel's fields, heading, prominence, and visibility.
The assessment-date field change does not alter the DX-17 header identifier.
The field-format refinement does not change the required DX17-DX20 variants, their editability, or their selection basis.
